method: Original matplotlib plots from this run's aggregate results and synthetic calculations

figures.name: historical-map-checks
figures.caption: Figure: Among Green et al.'s selected historical-map checks, form-line features had 150 positives among 393 tested features. Counts span archaeological periods and describe this selected sample.

figures.name: ganweriwala-area-definitions
figures.caption: Figure: The legacy 81.5 ha estimate, Gulzar's 66.7 ha December 2015 ground survey, and Orengo et al.'s approximately 33 ha visible mound use different spatial definitions. They cannot be combined into one statistical interval.

figures.name: observation-chain
figures.caption: Figure: A conditional observation chain separates occupation, survival, survey coverage, detection, attribution and publication. In constructed examples, 200 places recorded with overall probability 0.5 and 1,000 recorded with probability 0.1 each give 100 expected records. No actual missing-site total is estimated.

figures.name: synthetic-find-yield
figures.caption: Supplementary figure: Illustrative in-ground deposited densities of 5, 50 and 500 fragments per cubic metre, applied to a constructed excavation volume of 3,000 m³ at assumed 80% recovery, yield 12,000, 120,000 and 1,200,000 fragments. Recovery is applied once. These are constructed sensitivity examples.
